Why does voat have reply trees, but also a button to reveal more replies?
I do believe it is to save on bandwidth.

That and because if a post has 3 thousand comments (for example), it's better that the server send only a selection of the most upvoted posts in a well-organized manner than to just dump into the user all of them at once (which obviously most people won't bother reading entirely) or just the "first x ones" or "last x ones" since those could have a lot of downvoted comments or uninteresting ones. Picking a "best selection" of ones to send only while also allowing the user to see more by clicking on "another x replies" saves bandwidth and betters the user experience in one fell swoop, it's a win-win!
